title: model-eol eval results manifest
description: Eval results manifest `model-eol.eval/0.1` written by `model-eol-bot evaluate`. It binds one pass, fail, or timeout result per planned migration group to the evaluated default-branch commit (base_sha), the SHA-256 of the plan without its generated time (plan_digest), the SHA-256 of the effective eval settings (eval_config_digest), and each group's feed digest. Publication refuses a manifest whose digests, base commit, configured state, or result identities do not match its own independently regenerated plan. Compatibility: additive changes keep this version; any change that makes an existing manifest invalid or changes what a digest covers is a new version, and validators reject unknown versions. Matching its digests, base commit, and result identities against a regenerated plan, and the per-report byte cap from eval.max_report_bytes, need the consumer's repository and stay in code. Calendar validity of generated relies on `format: date-time`, which many Draft-07 validators treat as an annotation unless format validation is enabled; model-eol's validator enforces it.
